First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all skill levels, ride leaders. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Austin Ridge Riders Sunday Ride group ride

The Austin Ridge Riders mountain bike club runs a no-drop Sunday morning ride with dedicated ride leaders. Trails rotate around the Austin area. Details for each week are posted on the club's Meetup page.
